hack.root_cause: ERC777 reentrancy via newly integrated AMP token — reentrant `borrow()` before state update
hack.description: Cream Finance lost $18.8M when an attacker exploited ERC777 reentrancy hooks in the newly integrated AMP token to double-borrow from Cream's lending pool 17 times before state was updated.
